# Mega Man X: Complete Edition 1.0

Original release by CF, 31 December 2023:
https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/8335/
Preserved release page: https://neoromhacking.net/hackpage.php?id=8335

- CF: hacking and additional translation work.
- Windii Gitlord: retranslated script.
- PowerPanda: damage disassembly file.
- MottZilla: debug menu help.
- Ma?l H?rz: HxD, used by the original author.

These independently switchable mods adapt the original patch's dialogue and
combat tables to the stock USA Rev 1 ROM. The native practice menu and frame driver
around the stock editing routines are new integration code. No injected debugger code,
ROM image, or recompiled ROM-hack program is distributed here.

The original release specifies no license. Its authors retain their rights;
this adaptation does not relicense their translation or patch data as MIT.
Capcom owns the original game. The integration code follows the project license.

Requires a game build containing the corresponding `megaman-x.complete.*`
trusted plugin. Earlier game releases cannot activate these packages.
